messages.author: 3289366ed20f8028
messages.subject: Importing date fields into Distance 7.1
parts:
Hi folks,

When using the import wizard in Distance 7.1 for Windows, is it possible to import date (DD/MM/YYYY) fields and set them to a proper 'date' format rather than 'integer', 'decimal' or 'text'? Or, is the only solution to change them to something like Julian date and format them as 'decimal'?

Thanks
Esther

messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Importing date fields into Distance 7.1
parts:
Hi Esther, (cc list)

Yup, I'm afraid that Distance is only designed to cope with integer,
decimal or text. Your Julian date solution seems a good one, except I
think it would be better as an integer than a decimal. If you have
multi-year data, and want to preserve that info, then you could set the
date of the first survey as day 0 and count forward from there (or use
some other start day - when I were a nipper, computers used to use Jan
1st 1970 as day zero... oh, those were the days...).

Best wishes, Len
